Restaurant's favorite review
Vi Lai – A Vegetarian Gem in Hanoi’s French Quarter
Jun 2026 • Family
We had a truly memorable dining experience at Vi Lai Vegan Restaurant. As a vegetarian, I was excited to try their creative Vegan Fusion dishes, and each one turned out to be both delicious and beautifully prepared. The presentation was impressive, with every plate looking as good as it tasted.

We ordered a variety of dishes, and all of them were flavorful, well-balanced, and complemented by refreshing drinks. The staff were attentive and welcoming, which made the evening even more enjoyable.

The restaurant is located in the French Quarter inside a charming old building, giving it a warm and elegant atmosphere. It felt like the perfect setting for a special meal.

Overall, Vi Lai is one of the best vegetarian restaurants I’ve visited in Hanoi. The combination of excellent food, thoughtful service, and lovely ambiance made it a highlight of our trip. I would happily recommend it to anyone looking for quality vegetarian dining in the city.

Overhyped & Misleading Tourist Trap
Nov 2024 • Couples
My husband and I chose to dine here after seeing a lot of social media hype while we were researching restaurants in Hanoi. The photos they display in their marketing displayed a lot of impressive lounge seating. The exterior was cool as we walked in, with mist jetting outside, ut the interior looks like an abandoned Rainforest Cafe with 0 atmosphere. The restaurant is sectioned off into a bunch of smaller rooms with nothing more than brown walls and chairs. No music playing and just dead quiet. We asked the hostess where the lounge seating was that we saw online and she told us that they didn't have that seating anymore. After 10 minutes of waiting for someone to wait on us, we decided to head out somewhere else. 

Don't fall for this tourist trap. It's not worth the hype or the overpriced menu.

Oct 2023 • Friends
Quite likely the best vegetarian restaurant in not only Ha Noi, but in all of Viet Nam, and we've eaten at most of them, and are dedicated gourmands and foodies, including a professional vegetarian chef who has put out about a half dozen cookbooks (check The Blonde Vegetarian). Getting to enjoy all that in a private dining room with close friends is a lifetime memorable treasure.

Nature is sometimes not enough
Aug 2023 • Couples
Very beautiful place, where the lush green of the tropical nature is in full harmony with the environment and creates a very relaxing atmosphere. The spectacular entrance, with plays of lights, steam and water, promises an impeccable evening. Unfortunately, not everything always goes in the right direction. Beyond the large menu of good vegetarian dishes, the service is very poor and indiscreet. As soon as we sit down, we are joined by a waitress who demands an immediate order (without even having looked around), we need an electronic translation to ask for a few minutes of consultation. Nobody speaks English, the kids are distracted and a little awkward. At the time of payment, they make us repeat the operation four times, despite the authorization of the credit card transaction. In short, a "beautiful" place that doesn't "dance". The right measure of courtesy and awareness of a project is missing. A nice wasted opportunity.
